explanation.en: hasattr(object, name) checks whether an attribute can be found. getattr(object, name, default) reads it with an optional fallback. Without an attribute or default, getattr raises AttributeError.
explanation.nl: hasattr(object, name) controleert of een attribute gevonden kan worden. getattr(object, name, default) leest deze met een optionele fallback. Zonder attribute of default geeft getattr een AttributeError.

solution.main.py:
class Sensor:
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name

sensor = Sensor("East")
has_name = hasattr(sensor, "name")
reading = getattr(sensor, "reading", 0)
print(has_name, reading)

task.en: Set has_name using hasattr(sensor, "name"). Read absent reading with default 0 into reading.
task.nl: Bepaal has_name met hasattr(sensor, "name"). Lees de ontbrekende reading met default 0 naar reading.

checkpoints.check: has_name is True and reading == 0 and not hasattr(sensor,'reading')
